raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum Return — 12 Week Progressive Walk-Based Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Gentle postpartum return: rebuild endurance, mobility, and safe core activation"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Weeks 1–4 (Ob clearance: light activity only)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x15..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Walk + Gentle Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x15..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Walk + Pelvic floor focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x15..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Walk + Gentle Activation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walk + Pelvic floor focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Longer Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Walk + Introduction to low-load core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x20..20 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          dead_bug 2x6..8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk + Pelvic floor & mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + Gentle Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          dead_bug 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk + Pelvic floor":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Weeks 5–8 (Gradual progression; still no heavy lifting or traditional abs)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Brisk Walk + Core-friendly activation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Longer Walk + Pelvic floor":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Brisk Walk + Low-load core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25..25 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Long Walk + Activation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk with slight intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Core-friendly strength (bodyweight)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 40m "Longer Walk + Pelvic floor":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x35..35 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Brisk Walk + Glute focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x35..35 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Walk + Core-friendly":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Long Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x40..40 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 — Weeks 9–12 (After 6-week check: progressive low-impact strengthening and core re-introduction)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Walk + Bodyweight strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x35..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Walk + Core re-intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Long Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x40..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Split squat practice":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x40..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Walk + Core progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x35..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Long Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x40..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Walk + Core & balance":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x35..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Long Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Final week: Walk + Strength mix":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_floor_exercise 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Walk + Core consolidation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x40..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Long Walk — endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x55..55 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
